description: A Flutter widget class 'PaymentFragment' implementing a payment options UI with deep-link launching and payment confirmation dialog.

classes.name: PaymentFragment
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that displays payment options including wallet, QR pay, and third-party apps, with deep-linking and payment confirmation dialog.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the payment UI.

methods.name: _buildPaymentTile
methods.description: Helper method to create a payment method list tile with icon, name, link, and tap handler.

methods.name: _launchApp
methods.description: Attempts to launch an external app via URI; shows fallback message if unsuccessful.

methods.name: _showPaymentDialog
methods.description: Displays a confirmation dialog for completing payment, with success or failure feedback.
